INFORMATION REGARDING TENANT OBJECTION TO OWNER’S ADU DECLARATION AND REQUEST FOR HEARING:
(1) This Tenant Objection form must be filed within 30 calendar days of the date the tenant was provided the Owner’s
ADU Declaration and Notice re ADU construction pursuant to Planning Code Section 207(c){4). If the 30th day falls on
a weekend or legal holiday, this Tenant Objection form may be filed on the following business day.
(2) The tenant must specify below the particular statement(s) in the Owner’s ADU Declaration that the tenant disputes
and attach any evidence the tenant has to show that the statements in the Owner’s ADU Declaration are not true.
